outlet: Walla Walla Union-Bulletin, "Election Q&A with Joe Helm, Columbia County Sheriff incumbent" (2022-10-20)
notes: Helm won his first term in 2018 with 64% over Deputy Jeff Jenkins, after 11 years as chief deputy; 2022 priorities: crime and drugs, community-oriented policing, inter-agency collaboration, more staffing; says current drug laws 'tied our hands'; 21 years in law enforcement.
